description: Tell the vault which card product one of the user's own stored cards is (e.g. "Chase Sapphire Preferred", "Amex Gold"), so smart purchases can rank it. Takes a vault card id (a `vaultCards` row from list_cards) and the product name as the user says it; the closest match is saved and echoed back. Confirm with the user when the match is not obviously right. Pass clear_product to forget the name, or smart_excluded to keep a card out of the ranking without removing it.

card_id.description: The vault card id (from list_cards → vaultCards).

clear_product.description: true = forget the product name. Do not combine with product.

product.description: The card product as the user says it, e.g. "Chase Sapphire Preferred" or "Amex Gold". Four characters minimum.

smart_excluded.description: true = leave this card out of smart purchases; false = include it again.

name: name_card

matches.description: On no_match or an ambiguous name: the closest products found, to offer the user.

status.description: "named" | "cleared" | "updated" | "no_match" | "ambiguous" (several products match; nothing saved, ask the user) | "noop".
